title: Spill gates opened in 9 major reservoirs amid heavy rainfall
byline: Due to the prevailing rainfall, nine major reservoirs and five medium-scale reservoirs operated by the Department of Irrigation are currently spilling, the department announced.

title: Corpse found floating near Colombo Port sparks police inquiry
byline: An investigation has been launched by the Sri Lanka Police following reports of a body found in the sea off the coast near the Port of Colombo.

title: Four schools in Deniyaya to remain closed for two days amid spreading illness
byline: Four schools in the Deniyaya Education Zone that were temporarily closed due to a rapidly spreading flu outbreak among schoolchildren will remain closed for two more days.

title: UK deploys warship to Middle East with eye on potential Hormuz mission
byline: Britain said on Saturday it was deploying its warship HMS Dragon to the Middle East in preparation for a potential multinational effort to protect shipping in the Strait of Hormuz once conditions allow.

title: Putin says he thinks Russia-Ukraine war is coming to an end
byline: Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Saturday that he thought the Ukraine war was coming to an end, remarks that came just hours after he had vowed victory in Ukraine at Moscow’s most scaled-back Victory Day parade in years.

title: Heavy falls above 100 mm expected in most places over the island
byline: The low-level atmospheric disturbance in the vicinity of Sri Lanka is likely to develop into a low-pressure area around May 11, the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Sri Lankan passenger arrested with over 4 kg of ‘hashish’ at BIA
byline: A Sri Lankan passenger who had arrived in the country carrying a consignment of the narcotic ‘hashish’ has been arrested by officers of the Airport Police Narcotics Bureau  (PNB) at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) earlier today (10).

title: Vijay sworn in as Tamil Nadu Chief Minister
byline: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) president C. Joseph Vijay was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on Sunday (May 10, 2026), putting an end to almost six decades of alternating rule by the State’s two dominant Dravidian parties — DMK and AIADMK.

title: Sri Lanka President extends congratulations to Vijay on appointment as TN Chief Minister
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has extended its congratulations to C. Joseph Vijay following his swearing-in as Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, highlighting the deep-rooted historical, cultural, and people-to-people ties between Sri Lanka and Tamil Nadu.

title: Expert committee appointed to draft National Policy on Medical Education
byline: The Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education has appointed a special expert committee to draft a national policy on medical education in the country.

title: Ten injured in accident on Southern Expressway
byline: Ten people have been injured in a road accident that occurred near the 154th milestone on the Beliatta–Kasagala section of the Southern Expressway, police stated.

title: Met Department forecasts surge in rainfall across Sri Lanka
byline: A significant increase in rainfall is expected across the country over the next few days, according to Malith Fernando, a meteorologist attached to the Department of Meteorology.

title: Ex-President Mahinda Rajapaksa responds to CIABOC summons over Airbus probe
byline: Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa says he will comply with the summons issued by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) and appear before the Commission on the scheduled date.

title: Yal Devi train services to resume tomorrow
byline: The Yal Devi train service, which operates between Colombo Fort and Kankesanthurai, will resume operations from tomorrow (11), the Department of Railways has announced.

title: Iran’s Guards threaten US Mideast sites as Trump awaits Tehran response
byline: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards threatened on Saturday (May 9) to target US sites in the Middle East if its tankers come under fire, Iranian media reported, as Washington was left waiting for Tehran’s response to its latest negotiating position.

title: Increased electricity tariffs to take effect from tomorrow amid public backlash
byline: The increased electricity tariffs are scheduled to take effect from tomorrow (11).

title: Israeli strikes kill 39 in Lebanon
byline: Thirty-nine people have been killed in another day of intense Israeli strikes in Lebanon, the country’s health ministry said.

title: Car bombing and shootout kills 14 Pakistani police officers
byline: A car bombing at a police post in northwestern Pakistan followed by an ambush on police personnel rushing to the scene has killed at least 14 officers, police said on Sunday (May 10).

title: Factory in Homagama sealed over production of substandard iron rods
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority has taken steps to seal a factory in the Homagama Industrial Zone after it was found producing substandard iron rods without the mandatory SLS certification.

title: MPs appointed as district health coordinators under new Cabinet-approved healthcare reform
byline: The government has launched a new mechanism to strengthen the coordination of healthcare services at district level, aimed at improving efficiency in the delivery of preventive and curative health services across the country.

title: Spain starts evacuating virus-hit cruise ship in Tenerife
byline: Spain has started evacuating passengers from a hantavirus-stricken cruise ship anchored near Tenerife in the Canary Islands.

title: Free Lawyers organization alleges parliamentary committee report shields key figures in US$ 2.5 million cyber heist
byline: The Free Lawyers organisation has accused the Parliamentary Committee on Public Finance of attempting to protect the real culprits in a controversial payment involving the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Treasury.

title: Teenager drowns while bathing in Ma Oya in Mawanella
byline: A 15-year-old boy has died after drowning while bathing in the Ma Oya river in Mawanella.

title: Teachers Training College final examination for 2023/2024 to begin tomorrow
byline: Teachers Training College final examination for the 2023/2024 academic years is scheduled to commence tomorrow (11), the Department of Examinations has announced.

title: India, Sri Lanka agree to expedite Ditwah relief package
byline: India and Sri Lanka have agreed to expedite implementation of the post-Ditwah reconstruction package of USD 450 million that New Delhi offered after one of the worst natural disasters hit the country last year.

title: Use petrol, diesel carefully: Indian PM Modi
byline: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday said that the need of the hour is to use petro products with restraint in the wake of the West Asia crisis.

title: Motorcyclist killed in accident on Ratnapura–Balangoda road
byline: A 27-year-old individual has died following a road accident that occurred near the Bathgamgoda Junction on the Ratnapura–Balangoda main road, police stated.

title: Iran says it has responded to US proposal for ending war
byline: Iran has sent its response to the latest US proposal for ending the conflict that began at the end of February, according to state media.

title: World has lost about 1 billion barrels of oil in two months: Aramco CEO
byline: The world has lost about 1 billion barrels of oil over the past two months and energy markets will take time to stabilise even if flows resume, Saudi Aramco’s CEO ⁠said on Sunday, as shipping disruptions choke traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay signs three key welfare schemes on Day One
byline: New Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay signed documents related to three major welfare and governance initiatives on his very first day in office after assuming charge as the 17th Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu. The initiatives focus on women’s safety, youth welfare, and public wellbeing.

title: Final rites of former SriLankan Airlines CEO Kapila Chandrasena held at Borella Cemetery
byline: The final rites of former SriLankan Airlines Chief Executive Officer Kapila Chandrasena were conducted this evening (10) at the Borella General Cemetery.

title: Police issue notice on launch of digital motor insurance cards
byline: Police have issued a special notice regarding the issuance of digital motor vehicle insurance cards, which came into effect from May 1.

title: Sri Lanka’s foreign reserve assets fall below USD 7 billion
byline: Sri Lanka’s official reserve assets decreased to USD 6,759 million in April 2026 from USD 7,026 million recorded in March 2026.

title: “There’s work to be done” in Iran, Israel PM Netanyahu says
byline: Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said there is “work to be done” in Iran as he acknowledged that Tehran retains many of the capabilities it had at the start of the war.

title: Former India CJ says independent Bar essential to protect constitutional democracy in Sri Lanka address
byline: Former Chief Justice of India BR Gavai has said that an independent Bar plays a vital role in protecting constitutional democracy and citizens’ rights, stressing that lawyers must have the courage to defend institutional integrity ‘when silence is convenient.’

title: Heavy rainfall floods sections of Wellawaya–Colombo main road, disrupting traffic
byline: Several areas along the Wellawaya–Colombo main road have been inundated following heavy rainfall experienced in Wellawaya and surrounding areas tonight (10).
